name.es: Mesa fija de tilt sobre zapata de hormigón

description.en: Fixed-tilt ground table whose posts sit on cast-in-place or precast concrete footings. Suppliers mention concrete footings or precast blocks as an alternative to ramming. The footing dimensions, concrete class, reinforcement and anchor bolts are not stated in any source reviewed, so this entry is mostly not_found.
description.es: Mesa fija de tilt cuyos postes se apoyan en zapatas de hormigón hormigonadas in situ o prefabricadas. Los proveedores mencionan zapatas o bloques prefabricados como alternativa al hincado. Las dimensiones, la clase de hormigón, la armadura y los pernos de anclaje no se indican en ninguna fuente revisada; por eso la entrada es casi toda not_found.

typical_use: Ground arrays on soils unsuitable for driving or screwing, or where a concrete foundation is preferred.
applicable_standards: EN 1992 (concrete design, typical reference, not cited by sources)

materials.material: Concrete, class and strength not stated
Steel, galvanized (suppliers state galvanized posts; anchor grade not stated)

installation_notes: Suppliers offer concrete footings as an alternative to rammed posts; Sadef states concrete foundations are poured on site or supplied as pre-fabricated blocks (dimensions not stated).
ArcelorMittal lists post ramming or concrete footings as foundation options (dimensions not stated).
Excavation, concrete curing and anchor installation are not covered by the sources and need a civil design.
